sections.Profile:
The "Peter Pan" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company on March 29, 1955, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1955
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Boats, Single Player, Fictional Character, Wood Rail, Ocean, Fantasy, Book

- Design: Harry Williams
- Art: George Molentin
